text.p: Laboratory Specialists of America Inc said Friday it intended to take a one-time charge of $1.6-$2.1 million against 1996 earnings.
The charge is related mainly to the discontinuance of the clinical operations of the National Psychopharmacology Laboratory acquisition, it said.
It said that excluding the charge, earnings per share will exceed $0.20. In the previous year it reported earnings of $0.20 a share.
Laboratory Specialists said it expects continued growth in sales and earnings in 1997.

The company said that after several agreements to sell the clinical operations were not completed, management decided to cease operations at the Knoxville, Tenn., facility and focus attention on the profitable forensic drugs-of-abuse testing business.
